design: Same H959 lexical and template holdouts; average training quartet H958 shared budget1 state coordinates. Lexical controls template-conditioned or pooled, each full four-state versus additive subject+distractor state effects. Template holdout uses pooled states from training template. Frozen .1/top8 outputspan, bothseeds, allpredictions live MLP/joint. No activation inputs, no heldout target or norm use.
limits: Explicit semantic labels and template IDs are privileged controls, not discovered features. Additive/interaction refers to state coefficients on this factorial panel, not unique mechanisms of the original model. No downstream-based selection.
